steps.prompt_exact: Build me a self-contained browser FPS called Airlock Zero: Reactor Run. I want a short ray-cast space-station mission where I move through corridors, pulse security drones, recover three reactor cells, and reach the airlock before oxygen runs out. Make it polished and playable with keyboard and mouse plus a touch-friendly fallback, and keep everything in one offline HTML file with no external assets.
